name: retrieval-v2-bootstrap
provenance: The original 2026-06-12 40-query bake-off inputs were not recoverable; only aggregate scores survived in Claude project memory. This is a new v2 bootstrap corpus and must not be represented as the original set.
labeling: Queries were written as natural-language collection intents. relevant_slugs were fixed from BM25 top-1 on the 2026-07-21 indexes before generating Gemini query vectors, avoiding self-labeling from the hybrid ranker under evaluation.
limitations: Bootstrap labels contain one relevant slug per query and therefore measure known-item hit rate as recall.
English-only initial corpus; Korean and observed production failures must be added as separate rows.
BM25-derived labels require human review and should be supplemented by the append-only failure set.
